name: key
title: CCS-compatible provider domain rebuild
description: Planning package for a complete CLI-Manager-owned provider domain: full configuration editors, type common config, manual multi-key, global Home switching, native project/Worktree resolution, Home diagnostics, and CCS import.
creator: hxx
notes: Planning and prototype are complete. Phase 0 baseline is implemented: providers.db path/opener/schema, WAL and backup boundary, composite identity, manual-key constraints, and fixture tests. Phase 1 vertical slice is now implemented: native catalog/key repository and Tauri commands, secret-redacted DTOs, key projection/invariants, atomic active-key replacement, type-local common JSON editor with inheritance preview, and a localized Settings -> Native Providers catalog/editor with split-responsibility components. The legacy CCS read-only page remains isolated as an import source. Continue Phase 1/Phase 5 follow-up work for complete Claude/Codex/Grok document editors, Home apply, scope resolution, environment checks, and import wizard.
